conditions.evidence: adults with a diagnosis of dyslexia
conditions.label: dyslexia

output.population: Thirty-five adults with a diagnosis of dyslexia and 35 individuals without any diagnosis of language or reading impairment; Dutch first language, right-handed, age between 18 and 40
output.summary: Structural, diffusion, and task fMRI collected to investigate functional and structural differences in adults with dyslexia, using covert letter fluency, visual rhyme decision, and lexical decision tasks.
